sloka: गते तस्मिन् नरश्रेष्ठ दितिः परम हर्षिता ।कुशप्लवम् सामासाद्य तपः तेपे सुदारुणम् ॥१-४६-८॥
transliteration: gate tasmin naraśreṣṭha ditiḥ parama harṣitā ।kuśaplavam sāmāsādya tapaḥ tepe sudāruṇam ॥1-46-8॥

translations.english: "O foremost among men after Kasyapa had left, Diti exceedingly delighted (at the prospect of having sons) reached Kushaplavana, and practised intense mortifications.
